case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Riporta uptime e load/CPU pressure in uptime.txt
case.goal: Riporta uptime e load/CPU pressure in uptime.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Step: read load or CPU pressure.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `uptime.txt`.
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `uptime.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.

executed_commands: web_search|windows powershell get uptime command site:docs.microsoft.com
web_search|windows powershell get cpu load percentage command site:docs.microsoft.com

$bootTime = (Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object -ExpandProperty LastBootUpTime).ToUniversalTime(); $currentTime = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'; $uptime = (Get-Date $currentTime -UFormat).ToLocalTime(); $uptimeFormatted = [System.TimeSpan]::new($currentTime - $bootTime).ToString(); $cpuLoad = Get-Counter '\localhost\Performance\Processor(_TOTAL)\% Processor Time /s'; $loadValue = $cpuLoad.RawValue / 100; $loadString = $loadValue.ToString('P2'); $output = @($currentTime, $uptimeFormatted, $loadString); $content = "Uptime: $uptimeFormatted`r`nCPU Load: $loadString`r`nGenerated: $currentTime`; write_file|uptime.txt|$content

$uptime = (Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime; $bootTime = (Get-Date -F 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'); $cpuLoad = (Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor).CurrentLoad; $memInfo = (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory / 1KB; $content = "Uptime: $(if($bootTime -ne $null){$bootTime}else{Get-Date -F 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'}}\nCPU Load: $cpuLoad\nFree Memory: $memInfo MB"; $content
